item.title: Ente digest Oct 24, 2026 - 42 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
Photos received a broad set of usability and visual refinements across web and mobile, while Space video playback and Locker handling also improved. Several security, stability, and release-tooling updates landed alongside these user-facing changes.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Album creation is now more prominent, with a new tile before Favorites and consistent rounded album covers in #14039. On small screens, album download and sharing actions move into a three-dot menu (#14038), while navigation icons and viewer menus now use the updated Hugeicons design (#14037, #13992).
  • Album and People headers, search behavior, forms, unlock dialogs, notifications, and gallery feedback were standardized or refined across the web app (#14017, #14031, #14006, #13975, #13999).
  • Photos mobile: Importing from the device now uses Ente’s gallery picker, retaining zoom, selection, Live Photos, and the 50-item limit (#13960). Add-more selection, album editing above the keyboard, album pin ordering, location covers, video durations, and backup alerts also received fixes and improvements (#13974, #14001, #13780, #13881, #14026, #14005).
  • Space: Video opening, closing, and carousel playback are smoother, with more efficient preloading (#14009, #14000, #14019). Reaction long presses no longer accidentally open profiles (#14023).
  • Locker and platform safety: PDFs over 500 pages now fail fast instead of potentially stalling the viewer, and duplicate search results are removed (#13997, #13989). Guest view navigation is more tightly contained (#13968), while video preview IDs are validated server-side and legacy recovery tokens expire after 24 hours (#13980, #14002).
  • Desktop Electron was updated for stability and certificate mitigations (#14035). CLI documentation, packaging, KeePassXC storage, and release workflows also received maintenance updates.

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos web: Album and People headers will gain covers or face thumbnails, descriptions, and responsive spacing (#14040).
  • Space: Feed scrolling is being tuned to preserve video frames and playback positions while making deliberate carousel changes immediate (#14041).
  • Photos mobile: Hidden galleries will defer expensive grid rebuilds until visible (#14027), and iOS push registration is being updated for current Firebase/APNs fixes (#13988).
  • Other open work covers archived-album navigation, upload validation, bounded Space notifications, desktop packaging, and additional Auth icons (#14025, #14004, #13995, #14036, #14030).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 22, 2026 - 52 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos web redesigns alongside new Locker capabilities, sharing improvements, and security hardening. Several in-progress changes point to smoother backup activity, richer social interactions, and the next stage of Ente CLI and push-notification support.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Refreshed duplicate review with storage summaries and more responsive grouping in #13933, large-file review in #13931, and the File Info, EXIF, rename, location, and time-editing interfaces in #13910, #13919, #13917, #13922, and #13926.
  • Photos navigation and family management: Simplified the album sidebar in #13921 and delivered redesigned family settings, invitations, storage limits, and member actions through #13900, #13896, #13882, #13879, and #13877.
  • Locker: Image viewing and the redesigned upload screen are now available to everyone in #13904 and #13902; JPEG files also receive the correct icon in #13888.
  • Space: Encrypted post comments, threaded replies, reactions, and related notifications shipped in #13824.
  • Auth and security: Linux no longer exposes unsupported QR sharing in #13920, Auth HTML exports now escape codes in #13914, and access-reset session cleanup is safer in #13867. Server-side ID validation and log redaction landed in #13927 and #13874.
  • Documentation: New guidance covers face grouping, watch folders, recovery keys, family controls, and Auth code copying in #13930 and #13901.

In progress

  • Upcoming interactions: Space is exploring double-tap likes and swipe-to-reply comments in #13938, while Photos is redesigning backup status with filterable activity lists in #13937.
  • Push notifications: iOS keychain foundations are being added in #13892, following Android HPKE preparation already shipped in #13805.
  • Location albums, Legacy-kit confirmation emails, and first-release CLI preparation are underway in #13881, #13925, and #13929. Smaller cleanup work covers Locker permissions, image-support handling, and help-changelog syncing in #13936, #13934, and #13894.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 21, 2026 - 23 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos usability and layout improvements across web and mobile, alongside fixes for sharing, logout security, video processing, and CLI downloads. Several access-control and account-security improvements are also in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Refreshed family invitations with a clearer dialog and duplicate-submit protection in #13879, and standardized album, sorting, and family-member menus in #13880 and #13877.
  • Photos web: Continued separating gallery navigation, headers, album creation, sidebar selection, sorting, and download state, preserving existing behavior while simplifying the interface code (#13876, #13869, #13868, #13865, #13864, #13858, #13857).
  • Photos and Space: Web video processing now avoids heavy FFmpeg on iPhones where possible, reducing memory-related crashes (#13785). Space posts now show like counts and a list of likers (#13706).
  • Mobile: Auth and Locker now reliably clear app locks after logout (#13427), and the FFmpeg upgrade improves export and preview handling (#13559).
  • Sharing and CLI: Shared albums retain a sharee’s archived, hidden, and pinned state (#13848), while failed downloads can recover stale deleted entries (#13852).
  • Security: Recovery keys and admin login codes are no longer logged (#13874).

In progress

  • Photos: A refreshed family storage-limit dialog adds member usage, explicit limit choices, and a compact input (#13882).
  • Mobile Photos: Album-style covers and transitions are coming to locations across discovery and search (#13881).
  • Security and account handling: Fresh admin tokens will be required for MFA changes (#13873), access resets will revoke sessions created during the reset (#13867), and shared albums will refresh participant emails after email changes (#13854).
  • Auth: Verification codes will remain fully visible at large text sizes instead of wrapping and hiding digits (#13851).
  • Updated Photos and Locker help guidance is also in review (#13872).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 20, 2026 - 26 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes are concentrated in Ente Photos, with a substantial refresh of web public-link management and several navigation and usability improvements. The server also fixed shared-album synchronization issues, while work continues on comments, gallery controls, and device-album presentation.

Shipped

  • Photos web — public links: Links now have dedicated navigation and a searchable listing, with album covers, copyable URLs, and an Open album action (#13820, #13830). Users can also see the album name and photo count, choose link covers, and manage layout, expiry, device limits, and passwords inline (#13835, #13833, #13834, #13837, #13838, #13839). The dedicated Links navigation is visible to all users, while the duplicate Albums group was removed (#13840).
  • Photos web — navigation and browsing: Search now has an illustrated “No results found” state, People can reveal additional faces, and redundant All Albums/All People dialogs were removed. Mobile Albums and People navigation is now fullscreen and easier to use (#13815, #13821, #13823, #13818, #13817). Inline album headers are also aligned more cleanly (#13841).
  • Photos mobile: Gallery scrollbar track taps no longer accidentally change pages, and Similar Images handles photos missing file-size metadata without errors (#13832, #13813). The Search placeholder now respects the app language (#13822).
  • Server: Shared-collection fetches now preserve a sharee’s archived, hidden, and pinned state. Deleted shared collections are correctly reported during sync, with repair tooling for affected shares (#13848, #13844).
  • Space: Captions are hidden while the expanded post view is open and restored when it closes (#13846).

In progress

  • Space comments: Encrypted post comments, threaded replies, reactions, comment notifications, and synchronized counts are being added across the web, server, and Rust layers (#13824).
  • Photos mobile: Device albums are getting the newer album-cover design, Hero transitions, backup status, Slideshow, and Map actions (#13847). The gallery scrollbar is also being made easier to see and grab (#13836), and caption indicators are planned for gallery thumbnails (#13828).
  • Photos desktop and web: Desktop windows will recover onto a connected display instead of reopening off-screen, and web video playback is gaining a volume slider alongside mute controls (#13831, #13825).
  • CLI: Changing the export directory will correctly cause media files to be exported there (#13843).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 19, 2026 - 28 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente Photos saw a broad web navigation and usability refresh, alongside fixes to mobile browsing and sharing flows. Infrastructure work also advanced encrypted push notifications, while several upcoming media and Spaces features entered development.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Sidebar navigation is easier to use: users can search Hidden and Archive albums, create albums directly from the sidebar, and access quick links more consistently. See PR #13808, PR #13790, and PR #13818.
  • Photos web: People browsing now includes a “Show more faces” section, simpler navigation back to the overview, improved mobile drawer behavior, and clearer empty states for searches and albums. See PR #13821, PR #13823, PR #13817, PR #13815, and PR #13810.
  • Photos web: Empty albums can now be bulk-deleted from their overview, with the action protected by the shared confirmation dialog. Dialogs across Photos also now have a consistent design and behavior. See PR #13797, PR #13798, and PR #13801.
  • Photos mobile: Search text is now localizable, Similar Images no longer crashes when file-size metadata is missing, hiding an album no longer leaves the app stuck, and shared-photo backups warn when locations may be unavailable. See PR #13822, PR #13813, PR #13767, and PR #13646.
  • Notifications and Auth: The server can now register HPKE notification keys, Authenticator routes are restricted to Auth sessions, and Posteo accounts have a dedicated icon. See PR #13804, PR #13568, and PR #13791.

In progress

  • Upcoming Spaces feature: Encrypted post comments, threaded replies, reactions, comment notifications, and synchronized counts are proposed in PR #13824.
  • Photos web: A dedicated, searchable Links rail and listing is in progress in PR #13820, while PR #13825 adds a desktop video volume slider.
  • Push notifications: Android-side HPKE key storage and encrypted notification decryption are being prepared in PR #13805.
  • Other active work includes safer macOS media-key handling in PR #13795, lower-memory iOS video processing in PR #13785, and CLI audit fixes in PR #13826.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 17, 2026 - 13 shipped, 2 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes span Ente Photos, Ente Auth, Locker, the Rust CLI, and Ensu. Highlights include richer album navigation on the web, improved Auth tooling, and an internal Locker image viewer, alongside fixes for iOS builds and export metadata.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos web: Album group overviews add sidebar access, shared search and sorting, responsive album cards, and album creation.
  • Locker: An internal-flagged in-app image viewer now supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC, with zoom, sharing, downloading, and opening files in another app.
  • Ente Auth and CLI: Auth gained an authentication-code list and view with enrollment verification, while the CLI can now create accounts and enroll authenticators. Additional Auth fixes improve metadata parsing and clock guidance.
  • Photos exports: Native metadata is preserved during export.
  • Mobile reliability: Photos and Locker iOS builds were fixed after a libc regression.
  • Ensu: Version 0.1.22 highlights faster Android responses, and onboarding now sets up Ensu Packs and Your Notes after model download.
  • Other merged work includes interactive password retries and maintenance to the Rust core and test/dependency tooling.

In progress

  • Ente Auth: Aria service icon support would let Auth recognize Aria and its aliases during issuer matching. The PR is currently pending CLA.
  • Ente Photos mobile: A fix for the app getting stuck after hiding an album keeps the album usable until navigating back and adds regression coverage.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 16, 2026 - 33 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for Ente Photos, with major navigation and discovery improvements across web and mobile, plus smoother onboarding and gallery behavior. Locker, Ensu, the CLI, and export tooling also received notable updates.

Shipped

Ente Photos — web

  • Album group overviews add sidebar entry points, shared search and sorting, responsive album cards, and album creation.
  • People overviews now show portraits, names, and photo counts in a responsive grid, while People search makes larger lists easier to navigate.
  • People now prompts for machine-learning consent when needed, without losing the user’s current view if they cancel.
  • Album-related shortcuts are now correctly grouped under Albums in search, and exports no longer rename folders repeatedly when album names contain characters sanitized for filenames.

Ente Photos — mobile

  • Onboarding authentication screens now use the illustrated design, while local-gallery setup can recover after photo permission denial through retry or system settings.
  • Closing the viewer returns users to the last viewed photo in the gallery, with a matching transition. Album and People selection also share a unified sheet via this update.
  • Removed public links now disappear immediately from the Links list.

Locker, Ensu, and tooling

  • Locker gained an internal PDF viewer, and its new loading dialogs are now enabled for everyone via this change.
  • Multipart Locker uploads are available to internal users for files over 20 MiB.
  • Ensu 0.1.22 highlights faster Android responses, and Packs and Notes onboarding is set up after model downloads.
  • The Rust CLI gained account creation and authenticator enrollment plus server administration commands. Photos exports now preserve native metadata and support shared/hidden album filters through this export update and this filter update.

In progress

  • Mobile public album redesign: the web experience is being aligned with the native cover design, including full-width covers, date-range pills, edge-to-edge thumbnails, and grouped four-column grids.
  • CLI password retries and test cleanup are underway.
  • Family nudge emails will skip users already in a family, while coupon storage will trim whitespace and discard blank codes.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 14, 2026 - 33 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
Ente Photos shipped a broad set of navigation, gallery, sharing, and layout improvements across web and mobile. Ente Space also received smoother navigation and conversation interactions, while iOS PWA and build reliability fixes landed.

Shipped

  • Photos web: The new Albums/People sidebar now includes grouped filters, collection shortcuts, sidebar search, collapsible panels, and improved gallery spacing and highlighting. See #13669, #13671, #13680, #13683, #13684, and #13678.
  • Photos mobile: Gallery layout controls are more compact, sorting moved into album options, selection sheets respond faster, and sharing actions use a denser layout. #13675, #13677, #13699, and #13673
  • Album participants now see roles and a visible actions menu, while the Ready to backup flow has clearer choices and updated wording. #13692 and #13661
  • Ente Space: Feed batches no longer rearrange existing tiles while loading, and post transitions, photo reopening, profiles, conversations, and navigation received polish. #13691, #13679, and #13674
  • Locker and platform reliability: Upload V2 restores multi-selectable collection chips, and Photos/Locker iOS builds were fixed by reverting a broken libc update. #13672 and #13688
  • iOS PWA routing and layout fixes landed, including safer-area handling, conversation fixes, onboarding polish, and settings spacing. #13701 and #13696
  • Search no longer treats ordinary letters as word separators, preventing overly broad matches. #13513
  • FAQs across Auth, Photos, Ensu, and Locker were expanded and clarified. #13694 and #13693

In progress

  • A continuous pinch gesture will let mobile Photos users move between justified and three-to-six-column grid layouts. #13702
  • Album cover transitions, header handoffs, and face-loading retries are being refined. #13703
  • Shell completion is coming to the new CLI. #13698
  • Locker is cleaning up unused code, dependencies, and fonts. #13690

item.title: Ente digest Oct 13, 2026 - 42 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Today’s activity focused on a broad Photos navigation refresh across web and mobile, alongside usability improvements in Locker and several accessibility and infrastructure updates. Ente Auth also has an Apple Watch companion in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos web navigation: A new desktop header and navigation rail, collapsible layouts, and consistent navigation for Albums, People, Archive, Hidden, and cleanup views are now in place (#13636, #13651, #13657, #13653, #13655). Albums and People now appear in the rail, while Large files and Duplicates open inside the gallery instead of separate routes (#13627, #13631). The gallery sidebar also gains virtualization and a mobile drawer (#13669).
  • Mobile Photos polish: The share chooser is more compact, album and selection sheets behave more smoothly, the Ready to backup screen was refreshed, and long album names now truncate correctly (#13673, #13641, #13661, #13637). Checkbox state is now announced correctly by screen readers (#13658), and photo opening transitions are smoother with less thumbnail flicker (#13607).
  • Locker: Upload V2 again supports collection chips, including multi-selection and collection creation (#13672). Loading dialogs were refreshed across uploads, downloads, sharing, edits, and collection actions, with scanner entry and exit also made more reliable (#13640, #13644, #13647, #13642).
  • Other: Space feed grids and viewer interactions were restored and polished (#13645, #13643). The CLI gained Paste commands and improved account/token handling (#13656, #13654), while Photos exports now support hard links (#13630).

In progress

  • Grouped album filters: The Photos sidebar and album picker are being organized into Ente, Shared, Received, Links, and Empty categories (#13671).
  • Apple Watch support for Ente Auth: A native watchOS companion is being added to sync pinned codes and selected #watch-tagged accounts, with codes computed on the watch (#13652).
  • Shared-photo backup warning: Photos is gaining an optional reminder when shared images may not contain location data (#13646).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 12, 2026 - 35 shipped, 7 in progress

item.title: Ente digest Oct 10, 2026 - 13 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes focus on a refreshed Ente Photos mobile experience, faster and more reliable background syncing on Android, and smoother social interactions in Space. Locker also received fixes for exact password handling and more efficient collection counts, with related improvements in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: A redesigned album view now offers animated covers, clearer metadata, slideshow and map shortcuts, and more compact action sheets in PR #13445. New accounts also get redesigned Feed, Albums, and Received empty states with clearer actions and better large-text support in PR #13539. App labels in the “More from Ente” footer now wrap correctly at larger text sizes via PR #13526.
  • Photos syncing: Android can now register for Firebase push notifications and use album-triggered background sync in PR #13397. The server sends those sync pushes after eligible manual album shares in PR #13565.
  • Space: Friend profiles now host friend actions, requests use a sheet, and mobile navigation has improved spacing in PR #13580. Friend requests also appear directly in the Friends orbit with clearer accept feedback in PR #13570.
  • Locker and ML: Collection file counts now use a single database count query instead of loading every file in PR #13579. Photos mobile ML models now reuse Rust’s asset store for shared, more efficient downloads in PR #13567.
  • CLI help and noninteractive input improved in PR #13571. Routine web tooling, icon, formatting, and dependency cleanup shipped in PR #13576, PR #13572, and PR #13569.

In progress

  • Locker: Mobile and web now have proposed fixes to preserve leading, trailing, and whitespace-only Secret passwords when saving or editing: mobile PR #13584 and web PR #13586.
  • A proposed llama-cpp update brings a newer inference engine, chat-template bridging, and architecture-specific CPU optimizations in PR #13574.
  • Documentation explaining why a Photos language may not appear is proposed in PR #13575; web unused-export checking is being updated in PR #13578.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 09, 2026 - 37 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on a refreshed Photos experience, stronger media and ML foundations, and expanded Ente Space social features. Several security, notification, and account-data improvements also landed, while new work targets mobile video, onboarding, uploads, and encrypted notifications.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: The album page and action sheets received a substantial redesign, including animated covers, clearer metadata, slideshow/map shortcuts, and improved sorting access in PR #13445. Memories-ready notifications are now available to all eligible users rather than only internal users in PR #13524.
  • Photos media and ML: Mobile ML models now use Rust’s asset store, improving reuse and coordination of downloads in PR #13567. Browser and desktop FFmpeg moved to Ente’s 9.0.2 builds, adding AV1 thumbnail support, codec fixes, Windows ARM64 support, and better handling of paths with spaces in PR #13514 and PR #13536.
  • Space: Friends requests now appear directly in the orbit with clearer accept feedback, and a dedicated Notifications feed covers likes, friend requests, acceptances, and pokes in PR #13570 and PR #13533.
  • Auth and Locker: Auth gained export/decryption support in PR #13561, while mobile Auth can import empty plaintext and encrypted backups in PR #13546. Locker note titles now preserve emoji correctly and avoid an iPhone editing crash in PR #13564.
  • Server reliability and security: Album-share sync pushes now reach internal Android users, and push registrations are tied to login sessions in PR #13565 and PR #13519. Access through pending-removal memberships is blocked in PR #13535.
  • CLI and documentation: CLI help and noninteractive input improved in PR #13571. Several Photos, Auth, and sharing FAQs were clarified in PR #13562, PR #13560, and PR #13516.

In progress

  • Upcoming mobile Photos improvements: Permission-denial recovery in PR #13540, redesigned onboarding empty states in PR #13539, and encrypted iOS notification handling in PR #13538.
  • Video and uploads: Mobile FFmpeg 9.0.2 support is proposed in PR #13559, while web Photos may gain upload time estimates in PR #13528.
  • Ensu is testing a newer llama-cpp version and inference updates in PR #13574. Other open work covers Auth-only server routes in PR #13568, larger-text app labels in PR #13526, a Photos translation FAQ in PR #13575, and a new Auth service icon in PR #13541.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 08, 2026 - 33 shipped, 18 in progress
